messages:
suresh: Ran a cross-device autotune sweep this morning for L4/T4/A10 vs A100/H100. Quick summary: kernel picks diverge at seqlen >= 512; L4/T4 lean toward lighter matmul paths but p95 spikes for long sequences. Posting snippets + repros.

maya: 🙏 can you paste the autotuner command + top picks? any KV-cache regressions observed?

suresh: autotune command we used:
```
./bin/autotune --model gpt2-3b --devices l4,t4,a10,a100,h100 --seqlens 64,256,512,1024,2048 --batches 1..16 --metric tokens_per_sec --kv-mode cached
```
Output excerpt (top picks):
# device | seqlen | best_kernel        | tokens/s | p50_ms | p95_ms | mem_mb
L4       | 64     | matmul_split_k     | 12.3k    | 21     | 37     | 8200
L4       |1024    | matmul_split_k     | 6.2k     | 380    | 1180   | 10400
A100     |1024    | fused_attn_v2      | 18.9k    | 120    | 220    | 16000
H100     |1024    | fused_attn_v2      | 22.4k    | 95     | 190    | 15000
A10/T4   |1024    | matmul_split_k     | 7.1k     | 290    | 740    | 9800
```

suresh: KV-cache note: on L4 we see an extra host<->device memcpy during decode for cached KV lookups (not present on A100/H100 runs). That adds roughly 70-150us per token once seqlen > 512, which explains a lot of the p95 tail.

devon: Could be the batching heuristics + allocator interplay. Our current batcher uses max_batch_items + max_batch_tokens defaults (16000 tokens, 32 items). On low-memory cards that lets lots of small items with long seqs get bundled -> OOM pressure + memcpy thrash. Suggest: prefer token-limited batches for <16GB cards (cap to 8000 tokens).

maya: @devon can you sketch the runtime change? Also, can the kernel predictor include free_mem_mb and seqlen_percentile?

devon: yes. Plan: runtime/batcher - add heuristic weight for free_mem_mb and p75 seqlen. kernel_picker - add avail_mem param so we prefer fused_attn_v2 only when mem_mb > threshold. Also add a safefallback flag to force per-token streaming kernel if memcpy rate > X. I'll open a PR.

suresh: FYI found a regression after commit 9f3a2b: fused_attn_v2 fallback branch got tightened and now A100 sometimes chooses matmul path for tiny batches (bs=1,seqlen=64) which is slower. Repro: simple curl to the hosted endpoint shows 1.6x slower p50 vs previous.

suresh: repro command: curl -sX POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"model":"gpt2-3b","input":"hello world","device":"a100"}'

buildbot: deploy:green — rolled batcher/token-cap patch to staging 2026-03-15T11:22Z. Perf-run scheduled.

maya: Action items: (1) @devon open PR to add mem-aware batcher + kernel picker change; (2) suresh run extended autotune including seqlen 2048 and full KV-cached trace; (3) add KV memcpy metric to perf traces so we can alert on memcpy spikes.

suresh: adding KV memcpy and memcpy-per-token to perf pipeline now; will post updated autotune numbers in ~4h.

(quick notes: prioritizing changes that don't touch kernel implementations — prefer picker/batcher tweaks first to avoid regressions on A100/H100.)
